statement: Composite of SC10-N1..SC10-N3 (core is SC10-N1). [SC10-N1 — QUESTION, anc.ch10.relay-answer] My S2 realization makes 'too fast' a metric fact: the answer figure enters on beat 3 of the ask figure's own bar — ask onset + 2 beats, ~1.76 s at the ch10-ask mood's 68 bpm — inside the question's phrase, same level, same timbre, no accent, no hit (score-treatment.md, cue sc.ch10.relay-answer; provable by onset measurement against a ch5-maw call/response reference showing the shipped ≥1-bar gap). Constraint this places on the K7->K8 caption choreography: the audible answer must not arrive visibly BEFORE K8's paint begins, or sound scoops text and the pillar leaks as a production artifact instead of landing as a fact. Question: is K8's paint driven off anc.ch10.relay-answer itself (in which case we are aligned by construction and I need only the contract to say so), or off a K7 paint-completion event? If the latter, I need the anchor defined so that K8 paint-start ≤ ask onset + 2 beats, or I will retime the answer figure's entry beat to match the caption engine's actual breath — the relationship IS the meaning, so the contract must bind sound and paint to the same anchor, not to two clocks. Note the intent already nests anc.ch10.relay-answer inside the ask's phrase; I am asking for the caption-side half of that nesting to be stated as a contract term. [SC10-N2 — question, anc.ch10.cold-noticed] K1 says 'the hum has dropped a step.' My realization is a whole tone in the floor voice (sub root -2 semitones at the first phrase boundary after the anchor, upper voices held; semitone is the shipped dread interval and this chapter has no antagonist). Confirm the copy's 'step' tolerates whole-tone precision. Also: does the habitat core have, or gain this run, a diegetic hum SFX? If yes, the pitch move must live in exactly one lane (mine), the SFX staying static, proven on the combined bus — otherwise the step is double-attributed and K1's honesty audit fails at the mix level. If an SFX hum exists, route the coordination term to Integration. [SC10-N3 — info, anc.ch10.bearing-claimed] Recorded so reviewers have a home for it: station:bearing-claim waits indefinitely and receives NO score build, ever — a build would count down and convert the rite into a timer. The claim's acknowledgment is a phrase-boundary re-voicing around the carrier (making room), not a hit. If a naive viewer reports 'nothing happens musically while waiting at the relay,' cite this note as the authored choice, not a defect.
requestedAction: Answer SC10-N1: name the event that starts K8's paint and bind it to anc.ch10.relay-answer as a contract term (or accept my retime to the caption engine's real breath); confirm SC10-N2's whole-tone reading of 'step' and state whether a diegetic core-hum SFX exists this run; acknowledge SC10-N3 in reconciliation.

statement: Composite of SC10-N4..SC10-N6 (core is SC10-N4); also answers your SC-Q1..SC-Q3. [SC10-N4 — CONSTRAINT, anc.ch10.seam-of-light] My only texture event in transit fires here: sc.ch10.seam-ebb fades the rhythm section (percussion/ostinato) to zero through a named slew, leaving pad + sub + carrier. Your trigger spec (cinematography-treatment.md §7/§10-C3: atmosphereSpaceBlend ≥ SEAM_OF_LIGHT_MIN_BLEND 0.9 AND committed target within SEAM_VIEW_CONE_DEG 20 of view center; 0.9 > 0.78 as the galaxy temporal firewall) satisfies me on the blend term — monotone during ascent — and on the firewall. What is missing, stated precisely: the 20-degree view-cone term is player-controlled and re-crossable (look away, look back), and a player can also re-enter atmosphere, so as a LEVEL the compound condition can oscillate and pump my ebb slew audibly. Required contract term: anc.ch10.seam-of-light is a LATCHED EDGE — it fires exactly once per transit activation, the first instant both conditions hold, and never un-fires for the remainder of the beat regardless of subsequent look direction or blend value; re-arming only via the shipped beat-exit/deep-link/replay reset states (reset-score/reset-camera semantics). With that one sentence in the contract my ebb is safe and I sign the seam trigger as specified, hysteresis unneeded because a latch is stronger than hysteresis. [SC10-N5 — info, answers SC-Q1 + SC-Q2/C4] SC-Q1 (veil-clearing, not crescendo): agreed by prior construction — my cue is an acknowledgment by SUBTRACTION, not a build; the riser rail is flat across the entire beat (deliverable evidence/score/transit_seam-ebb_combined.wav proves it), so nothing musical swells for the image to ride; the line being already whole when the sky finishes going black is matched by music that loses its pulse rather than gains one. SC-Q2 (2.5 s thrust-cold hold at anc.ch10.station-resolved): YES it affects my timing, and I adapt on my side — my station-resolved re-voicing (carrier octave-double + one hearth [0,7,12] quotation) was specified at the next PHRASE boundary, which at 68 bpm can land up to ~3.5 s after the anchor, i.e. after your hold releases. I am retiming it to the first BEAT-grid point after the anchor (≤ ~0.9 s at 68 bpm), so the octave-double sounds INSIDE the engine-quiet and the two events read as one shared silence-then-sound. No change requested of you beyond what §7 already states: keep the hold's start bound to anc.ch10.station-resolved exactly, not to a wall-clock offset from an earlier event. Your no-awe agreement is mutual: no mediant, no braam, no lead entrance at resolve; run intensity max 0.44 via scoreIntensityFor (signedSceneAvRuntime.ts:349). [SC10-N6 — info, answers SC-Q3, ST-0] Confirmed and recorded for the deferred pedal packet: ST-0 receives zero score presence this run (declared silence, score-treatment.md); the ch10 carrier is a HELD tone with no periodic articulation, so no rhythm exists to lock to the 90 s transit period; and I adopt your rule prospectively — any future packet color near free play must avoid 90 s-locked periodicity, which would constitute a cue by stealth. This term should carry into the deferred packet's scope note verbatim.
requestedAction: Add the SC10-N4 latch sentence to the seam-of-light anchor definition in the scene contract (fires once per transit activation on first satisfaction, never un-fires within the beat, re-arms only via shipped resets); acknowledge SC10-N5's beat-grid retime so the hold and the octave-double are contracted to the same anchor; carry SC10-N6's no-90s-periodicity term into the deferred pedal packet's scope note.
